title: Shared split-attachment data and normalization
statement: For an n-truncated simplicial formal family K [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-coskeleton, def-weil-pbc-formal-coproduct], retain the existing degree, term, operator, nondegenerate-index, label, splitness, boundary-cone, matching-object, attachment-family and inclusion definitions verbatim. If K is split, normalization in degree q is the inverse equivalence to labelIndex: it takes an index to its unique epi label and nondegenerate index. Precomposing the epi part with an epi gives a label in the new source degree. If all old index sets are finite, Labels K q is finite for every q.

source.place: Tags 0DAV (lemma-hypercovering-object), construction and omitted composition verification, and 0DAU (lemma-split); explicit normalized-coordinate expansion of the finite attachment argument.

proof.text: Take the inverse of the equivalence induced by the bijective labelIndex map. Precomposition preserves epimorphisms by epi_comp, with the nondegenerate component unchanged. For finiteness, each nondegenerate subset is finite, the simplex-category hom set is finite because the ordinals are finite, and the finite product and sigma instances conclude.
